name: Eternal Aegis

abilities.name: Triple Strikes
abilities.description: A basic melee attack dealing high physical damage.

abilities.name: Fanning Strike
abilities.description: The Eternal Aegis shields itself with its swords, before striking out with all of them, dealing massive physical damage. This attack can be blocked.

abilities.name: Blade Throw
abilities.description: The Eternal Aegis brings its swords in the air and they start to glow. It then throws them across the arena before they all come back, indicated by traveling circular AoEs, dealing high physical damage on the way to and from.

abilities.name: Ring of Blades
abilities.description: The Eternal Aegis rapidly spins his blades around itself, indicated by a ring AoE that covers the area at a medium distance, dealing continuous very high physical damage. This can block party members' attacks. Stick close or very far to the boss to remain safe.

abilities.name: Summon Lesser Aegis
abilities.description: Throughout the fight, the Eternal Aegis will cast off pieces of itself to form Lesser Aegises. They have low health and can be cleaved quickly.

related_quests: Unhallowed Grave: Help the last Pyre Watch Sentinel and a vampire investigator in the Unhallowed Grave.
Pledge: Unhallowed Grave: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Unhallowed Grave.
summary: The Eternal Aegis is a construct which can be found guarding the way to the deeper parts of the Unhallowed Grave. It is the third boss of the dungeon.
